title: Penguin Love
description: Penguin Love Puzzle – Template for Construct 3 is a game Arcade it’s a classic style game, developed with Construct 3, Touch the squares and swap them to solve the puzzle and reach the penguin’s goal. This template developed with Construct 3, has a clean and orderly code, which will make it very easy for you to reskin and publish your own game, or simply see the code and understand certain functions to implement them in your own developments.
